name: eonik-mcp
description: eonik in Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex and VS Code: make adapts of a creative, revise them, check, send for approval and deliver, run in your own eonik app on your Mac.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check:registry && npm run build
scripts.check:registry: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'),s=require('./server.json');const e=[];if(s.description.length>100)e.push('server.json description is '+s.description.length+' chars; the registry allows 100');if(s.version!==p.version)e.push('server.json version '+s.version+' != package.json '+p.version);for(const k of s.packages||[])if(k.version!==p.version)e.push('server.json package version '+k.version+' != '+p.version);if(e.length){console.error(e.join('\\n'));process.exit(1)}"
